titleDv: ޤާނޫނު ނަންބަރު 8/2020 (ފެނާއި ނަރުދަމާގެ ޤާނޫނު) އަށް ... ވަނަ އިޞްލާޙު ގެނައުމުގެ ބިލު
summary: This bill amends the Water and Sewerage Act (No. 8/2020). It changes Articles 8, 11, 15, 25, 43, 54 and 62. Several articles get new clauses and one clause each in Articles 8 and 15 is deleted. It also changes the fines in Article 54, with figures of MVR 1,000,000, MVR 100,000 and MVR 5,000 printed. A date of 2027 appears in the new text of Article 8. The pages that compare old and new wording are rotated and hard to read, so some details are uncertain.
whyItMatters: Water and sewerage service providers could face different duties and larger fines, and the new text of Article 8 sets a 2027 deadline for something.
keyProvisions: Article 8: adds new clauses, one of which refers to the year 2027, and deletes two existing clauses. The wording of the new clauses could not be read reliably.
Article 11: adds two new clauses about the duties of service providers. The wording could not be read reliably.
Article 25: adds a clause that refers to Law No. 4/93 and to sewage or waste water being handled in line with that law.
Article 54 (penalties): adds a fine of up to MVR 1,000,000 in one clause and MVR 100,000 in another. A further clause mentions MVR 5,000, which appears to be a per-day amount.

Article 62 (definitions): adds definitions of 'water and sewerage service provider' and a second related term. Clause 13 says the amendment takes effect on ratification and publication in the Gazette.
whoIsAffected: Water and sewerage service providers, island councils and utilities, and households and businesses that use their services.
statedReasons: The short explanatory note says the bill is brought to amend the Water and Sewerage Act (No. 8/2020) in several articles; the full wording of the reasons could not be read reliably.
